name: pytest-scope
description: Routes bare pytest through the project interpreter and requires a test file or node-id per pytest run

python.title: Project Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the interpreter bare pytest should run under (for example a venv or conda env python.exe). Leave empty to turn the rewrite off. The harness plugin approves the rewritten call when the bare pytest call is allowed; without it, allow "<this path>" -m pytest in the Bash permission rules.

require_test_file.title: Require a test file per pytest run
require_test_file.description: Deny pytest calls that name no test path or a directory; a file or a node-id runs. /pytest-broad-ok allows the next broad run once.
